name: Tempo matching ramp
lesson:
## Land on the number and stop

Sync off. Move TEMPO B up by a small amount over 2 bars, hold 4, then across the centre to the same distance below over 4 bars, hold 4, and back to centre over 2. The goal is arriving at each value without overshooting and then not touching it.

The sound of bad beatmatching is oscillation: pushed too far, pulled back too far, and so on. A pitch fader has enough resolution that a 3% move is a visible travel; make that travel one continuous motion at one speed. Your beat-lock will come from your ear later; the hand discipline comes from here.
